profile.name: Priya Natarajan
profile.subline: New-grad fintech and data roles for a May 2027 graduate · Tailored to your September 2026 resume
profile.stack: SQL, Python, Power BI, dbt, Snowflake, Excel
profile.target: New Grad FT · Austin / Remote · Fintech + Data
profile.summary: Lead with the dbt models you shipped on Snowflake at Dell and the Power BI dashboards sales ops actually used; that combination of modeling and stakeholder delivery is rarer than either alone. Your finance minor is what makes the fintech employers on this list a natural fit rather than a stretch. Because you are staying in Austin, treat the Utah half of this board as reference only.
profile.applyNow: **Stripe New Grad Software Engineer** and the **Databricks 2027 Associate Product Manager** program are the two live board roles that actually hire remotely into Austin. Everything else live on this board is seated in Utah.
profile.watchLater: Q2 and Charles Schwab post their Austin analyst reqs through the fall, and Dell's full-time analyst openings follow the intern conversion cycle in the spring.

suggested.name: Dell Technologies
suggested.why: **Your current employer, and the shortest path you have.** You already shipped Power BI dashboards on their data; ask your BI manager to refer you into a full-time analyst req before it posts publicly.
suggested.note: Hires new grads into analyst and engineer roles posted on jobs.dell.com; search 'associate' or 'early career' and set an alert for Round Rock.

suggested.name: Q2 Holdings
suggested.why: **The clearest Austin fintech match on this list.** Q2 builds digital banking software, so your finance minor plus SQL and dbt work reads as directly relevant rather than as a career change.
suggested.note: Posts associate and entry-level analyst roles on their careers site through the fall; search 'associate' and watch their Austin listings.

suggested.name: Charles Schwab
suggested.why: **Large Austin campus with a real early-career pipeline.** Schwab hires finance-plus-data analysts, which is exactly the blend of your MIS degree and finance minor.
suggested.note: Runs a formal early-career program with fall application windows; look for 'Associate' and rotational analyst titles on their Austin campus.

suggested.name: Indeed
suggested.why: **Austin's biggest homegrown tech data org.** They hire entry-level data scientists and analysts, and your dashboard-to-decision work is the sort of applied evidence they screen for.
suggested.note: Hires new grads into data science and analyst roles; search their careers site for titles ending in 'I' and for university recruiting postings.

suggested.name: Oracle
suggested.why: **Austin headquarters with a volume new-grad pipeline.** Oracle hires broadly into cloud and data roles, so this is a reliable application even if it is not the most exciting one on your list.
suggested.note: Recruits new grads year-round into cloud and data roles; search 'Business Analyst' and 'Data Engineer' on oracle.com/careers filtered to Austin.

suggested.name: Visa
suggested.why: **Payments fintech with an Austin technology hub.** The finance minor plus SQL is a good fit for their analytics and risk teams.
suggested.note: Runs a university program with fall deadlines; look for 'Analyst' and 'Data Analyst' roles tagged to Austin.

suggested.name: Self Financial
suggested.why: **Small Austin fintech where a generalist analyst matters more.** Credit-building products mean the data work is close to the business, which suits your finance background.
suggested.note: Small team, so postings are sporadic; check their careers page directly and search 'analyst'.

suggested.name: USAA
suggested.why: **A short drive south, and a heavy hirer of finance analysts.** Worth an application if you would consider San Antonio or a hybrid arrangement.
suggested.note: Large early-career program with structured fall hiring; search 'Decision Science Analyst' and 'Data Analyst' on their careers site.

suggested.name: Bumble
suggested.why: **Austin consumer tech with a real analytics function.** Fewer entry-level seats than the big employers, so treat it as an opportunistic application.
suggested.note: Occasional analyst openings; watch their careers page rather than waiting for a program.

suggested.name: Netspend (Global Payments)
suggested.why: **Payments processing in Austin.** Less glamorous than Q2, but the analyst work is genuinely finance-adjacent and the local pipeline is steady.
suggested.note: Search Global Payments' careers site for Austin analyst roles; entry titles are usually 'Analyst I'.
